## Purpose

Describe the user-facing change and the affected pages or educational content.

## Verification

- [ ] Ran `npm test` (when backend changes)
- [ ] Ran `python3 build_site.py` and `python3 tests/static_audit.py` (when content or pages change)
- [ ] Checked links, mobile layout and accessibility where relevant
- [ ] Reviewed privacy, student data and authorization impacts
- [ ] Did not commit tokens, passwords, personal information or private student submissions
- [ ] Verified any claimed official PYQ against its exam, year, paper and answer key
- [ ] Confirmed copyright and publication rights for images, textbooks and other assets

## Deployment

State whether the change updates only repository files or requires Cloudflare Pages, D1 or R2 configuration.
